name: pg_partition_prune_incorrect_multi_column
goal:
Range partition pruning can skip or retain the wrong partitions when a condition constrains only a prefix of a multicolumn partition key.

For a table partitioned by RANGE `(a,b)`, a condition such as `a <= 1` must retain every partition whose bounds can contain that prefix, including the default partition, while pruning a partition wholly above it. In the complementary layout, `c1 > 7` must prune the explicit partition that cannot match and retain the default where needed. EXPLAIN and actual results must agree for inclusive and exclusive operators; fully constrained keys and single-column range pruning must not regress.
